title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
slides: Can privacy really win the AI assistant race?
Ollie stores all your data locally on device.
Unlike rivals, it never trains on your conversations.
Your sensitive chats stay yours—not corporate profit.
Test it with one private prompt you fear leaking.
thread_text:
1. Your chats are their profit

Ollie is an AI assistant that keeps all your data on-device, unlike rivals who train on your conversations.

2. The privacy trade-off

Mainstream AI tools analyze what you type to improve their models. Ollie flips that: your data stays with you.

3. No training on you

Other assistants learn from your messages for free. Ollie refuses—it never uses your chats to improve its system.

4. Corporate data goldmine

Your sensitive conversations become product for big tech. Ollie ensures your private chats stay yours, not a revenue stream.

5. Try a private prompt

Think of one prompt you’d never want leaked. Test it on Ollie and see the difference. Will you?
video_script: Privacy wins with Ollie's local data.
Your chats never train the AI.

script: Privacy wins with Ollie's local data.
Your chats never train the AI.

instagram.caption:
Your private chats are the product—unless the assistant never sees them beyond your screen.  

Ollie keeps everything on-device and refuses to train on your conversations. Rivals use what you type to improve their models, for free. That means your sensitive exchanges aren't sold or repurposed.  

For anyone writing drafts, brainstorming plans, or confiding in a tool, this changes what you can safely type. Your unprotected prompts become data; with Ollie, they don't.  

Before you trust any assistant, ask: what would I never want leaked—and would I type it here? 🛡️🤖🔒
